look: Midnight telethon, crochet hood, sleeping phones
prompt: A late-night charity telethon host at midnight, photographed on a modern smartphone from the audience floor: slightly tilted, mixed light, a little noise. A single man stands square to the lens on a big stage, hand mic held high, rattling an empty collection bucket upside down at the camera. Sequinned dinner jacket, bow tie undone and hanging, a giant charity ribbon pinned on, white cotton magician's gloves running under his cuffs. Behind him, under cold blue light, rows of phone-bank volunteers have fallen asleep on their tables; above them a giant totaliser board of blank flip panels. Warm spots on him, coloured sweeps from moving heads. Take only the ring-and-triangle layout from the attached image, nothing else. His hood is granny-square crochet in orange, teal and cream, one unbroken surface tucked into his collar; the face area is plain solid teal, traced at its outer edge by a thin cream-white ring, with a small solid red rounded triangle well inside it, upper right of the picture, over his left eye. Thanks.

look: Saturday variety crash-zoom, leopard hood, confetti
prompt: A Latin American Saturday afternoon variety show host: a 1990s broadcast camera frame mid-crash-zoom, zoom blur at the edges. A single man in a loud glossy white suit with gold buttons and very wide lapels, open-collar shirt, throws one arm wide toward the lens and holds a hand mic with a plain triangular mic flag up high, leading the packed, cheering tiered audience close behind in the sponsor's jingle. Dancers in feathers at the side; a confetti cannon fires straight into the side of his head. Hot mixed stage light, chaser bulbs around the set, strong colour. Shiny gold vinyl gloves with a small ring-and-triangle patch on the back, cuffs over the wrists. Take only the ring-and-triangle layout from the attached image, nothing else. His hood is tan-and-black leopard-print faux fur, one unbroken surface tucked into his collar; the face area is plain tan fabric, traced at its outer edge by a thin cream-white ring, with a small solid red rounded triangle well inside it, upper right of the picture, over his left eye. Thanks.
